primaryChecks.pageRole: pages1–6 official operator list for Wirtschaftswissenschaften among named subjects
primaryChecks.ownBoundedParaphrase: Demand levels depend on the task context. The table allows ranges: explaining is II, calculations and classification I–II; analysis I–III, comparison and reasoned assessment II–III. A single verb alone is not a global retaxonomy.
The SDGs are a shared development-goal framework linked to Agenda2030. Poverty, energy and other aims differ from a climate treaty; names alone do not guarantee implementation.

primaryChecks.pageRole: official treaty overview, national contributions, cooperation and transparency
primaryChecks.ownBoundedParaphrase: Paris is a climate treaty involving national contributions, adaptation/finance cooperation and reporting. These mechanisms require actual implementation and do not by themselves guarantee every local outcome.
Non-performance after a reasonable unsuccessful period supports conditional withdrawal, subject to exceptions and exclusions. Withdrawal is not a universal fault-dependent compensation claim.

primaryChecks.pageRole: responsibility and loss condition; direct opens timed out, official indexed normative content retrieved
primaryChecks.ownBoundedParaphrase: Damages require caused loss with responsibility subject to the statutory exoneration rule. Unresolved responsibility must not be presented as a blanket creditor burden to prove positive fault.

primaryChecks.pageRole: damages instead of performance additional conditions
primaryChecks.ownBoundedParaphrase: This remedy adds performance-period and related conditions to the general damages framework; it is not automatically established by withdrawal.
Defect remedies follow their respective statutory conditions; the gateway does not award every remedy automatically.
Cure is governed by stated remedies and conditions and remains distinct from blanket immediate reimbursement.
Express refusal of proper cure can remove the formal additional-deadline requirement in the consumer-sale withdrawal path.
Conforming delivery and ownership transfer are balanced with payment and taking delivery.
The agreed result, rather than activity alone, distinguishes the main promise.
Promised activity and remuneration differ from a guaranteed successful result.
Manufactured movable goods principally follow sales law, with remaining specified rules. The supplied non-digital cases do not invoke the digital-product branches.
